sentences.translation: It's been a week since Erin started attending high school in Japan.
Today Erin will talk about school life in Japan.
Erin: At first, there were many surprises at Japanese schools.
First, the class is decided, and the teacher comes to the classroom.
In the United States, students moved around the classroom, so it was strange at first.
Then, lunch!
Every day, lunch leaves school.
The person in charge of the table arranges and eats it by saying "I'll eat it" with everyone.
The menu is full of Japanese dishes, and it is about two dishes of rice, miso soup and side dishes.
i asked my friend yukasan.
Eryne: Yuka, when have you eaten lunch?
Yuka: I've been in elementary school since I was a freshman.
I've been used to it for a long time.
erin: do you have to eat all of them?
Yuka: I'm told I'm going to eat it, but my teacher says I can leave it.
Is Erin a bad guy?
Erin: Natto is a little...
Yuka: That's what many foreigners say.
But if you like natto in your class, you'll have to eat it!
Erin's narration:
After school, there is a club activity.
The club is a club of sports and cultural activities.
I joined the badminton club.
The time of club activities is about one and a half hours to two hours.
There are practice every day, and there are also games and practice on weekends.
The relationship between seniors and juniors is important in the Japanese club activities.
The upper grader calls him "senpai," and the lower grader calls him "junpa."
The juniors speak politely to their seniors.
I spoke to the senior of the badminton club, senior Tanaka.
Erin: Saka Tanaka, can I ask you to tell me?
Tanaka: That's fine.
But you don't have to be so hard.
Speak a little easier.
Erin: Oh, I'd like you to tell me.
Saka Tanaka: Yes, yes.
please.
First, I'll show you how to hold the racket.
Erin's narration:
The school schedule is often six hours a day.
The class is 50 minutes long and there is plenty of time to rest.
The long break between classes is called "Hiruyasumi".
After eating lunch, I spend time in the classroom and hallway.
In the home room on the way home, the teacher will tell you the contact information.
"We have a gym class tomorrow. Don't forget to wear gym."
Thus, Erin's school life continues.
